Implemented the fix in [SyncSupplierInventory.php](/app/var/workspaces/lock-leak-on-exception--laravel-13--1/app/Jobs/SyncSupplierInventory.php).
Diagnosis: supplier failures caused `response->throw()` to exit before `$lock->release()`, leaving `inventory-sync` held and causing every later job to skip.
The locked work now runs inside `try/finally`, guaranteeing release while allowing supplier exceptions to propagate for queue retries.
Verification: PHPUnit passes — 2 tests, 3 assertions.
